options.title: FedEx Was Down to {fact1}. Its Founder Went to Las Vegas
options.first_line: FedEx was down to its last {fact1}, and its founder flew to Las Vegas.
options.first_frame: A FedEx envelope on a doormat pushing in, the FedEx name sharp, its last cash on a label beside it.

options.title: FedEx's Founder Bet Its Last {fact1} at Blackjack
options.first_line: FedEx's founder took the company's last {fact1} to a blackjack table.
options.first_frame: A FedEx plane on the runway, then a cut to cards on a blackjack table.

options.title: FedEx Had {fact1} Left. Its Founder Didn't Pay the Bills
options.first_line: FedEx had {fact1} left, and its founder didn't spend it on the bills.
options.first_frame: A FedEx truck at the kerb, a red stamp LAST CASH landing on its side.

why: A names FedEx, which the viewer has had on their own doormat, and a founder flying to Las Vegas with the last cash makes you ask what he did there and how it saved the company, without giving the blackjack twist away the way B does.
